Material compatibility is acceptable with PFA tubing, which is robust against the acidic DMF/AcOH mixture at 20°C. The primary safety mandate is to enforce a positive back-pressure to maintain liquid phase stability and exclude oxygen, alongside standard PPE for DMF handling.
